🚀 From a single room in the back of a tanning salon… to **62+ med spa locations nationwide** 🌎🏥.  

This week on *The Aesthetic Edge*, I had the privilege of interviewing **Joe Stanoszek**, the visionary founder of **VIO Med Spa** — one of the fastest-growing medical aesthetics franchises in the country.  

Joe didn’t just build a brand — he built a movement. In our conversation, we pulled back the curtain on:  
✨ How VIO scaled from 1 room to 62 thriving locations  
📈 The biggest growth lessons (and mistakes) when building a med spa franchise  
💙 Why *culture* is the ultimate growth multiplier  
📜 Navigating state-by-state med spa rules (and staying compliant)  
🎯 Proven strategies for client acquisition & retention  
💉 The *free syringe* marketing tactic that delivers magic results  
🔮 The future of wellness in aesthetics — and why now is the moment to lean in  

Whether you’re an injector, med spa owner, or future franchisee, Joe’s story is packed with **real-world strategies** you can use to grow sustainably, strengthen your team, and create a brand clients can’t stop talking about.  

🎧 Watch the full episode here: [YouTube Link]  
💼 About New Era Intel: I help aesthetic practices grow from A to Z — identifying bottlenecks, streamlining systems, and creating high-converting marketing campaigns that keep clients coming back.
